items.why: Falling as the broader market rallies. Headlines asking whether this is the beginning of the end of the AI stock market boom are weighing on mega-cap tech.
Up with the broader tape as dip buying resumes and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq climb, per Yahoo Finance. No single Tesla-specific headline.
Small caps riding the broad rebound as solid earnings and falling crude oil lift stocks, per CNBC. Moving with the broader tape.
Down while Wall Street gains ground. An economist warns an AI bust could come from places investors are not watching, souring sentiment on AI names.

summary: Stocks are higher Tuesday afternoon, with the Dow jumping 500 points on solid earnings and falling crude oil. Tech and AI names stay mixed as headlines question whether the AI stock boom is nearing its end.
